S.FORM: tee=ku pu-a-kari-kari pu-a-iisua takio mia niŋai vaəsə.
S.PHON: teeku puakarikari puaiisua takio mia niŋai vaəsə
S.FORM: teeku puakarikari puaiisua takio mia ningai vaese.
S.PHON: teeku puaka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]i puaiisua takio mia niŋai vaese
S.TRANSL: I shall talk about Takio being bitten by a snake.

S.FORM: kaʔan=ku taavalaʔə mia-iisua si ʔaisi mu-a-ʔuma.
S.PHON: kaʔanku taavaɾaʔə miaiisua ʂi ʔaiʂi muaʔuma
S.FORM: ka'anku taavara'e miaiisua si 'aisi mua'uma.
S.PHON: kaʔanku taava[r|ɾ]aʔe miaiisua ʂi ʔaiʂi muaʔuma
S.TRANSL: At that time, I didn't know what happened because I was working in the fields.

S.FORM: kaʔan=ku taavalaʔə ʔacu=ava iaʔi=cu natia maica cakəran misai
S.PHON: kaʔanku taavaɾaʔə ʔaʦuava iaʔiʦu natia maiʦa ʦakəran misai
S.FORM: ka'anku taavara'e 'acuava ia'icu natia maica cakeran misai
S.PHON: kaʔanku taava[r|ɾ]aʔe ʔaʦuava iaʔiʦu natia maiʦa ʦake[r|ɾ]an misai
S.TRANSL: I didn't know he would really go and cross the river.

S.FORM: caʔania=cu ni-ku-caʔan=cu caʔania ni-i-vatu sua ma-manu=maku piiʔi i-vatu taansua, ni-i-vatu taansua niŋai=kani kulai takio misai ara-kicacə=ku.
S.PHON: ʦaʔaniaʦu nikuʦaʔanʦu ʦaʔania niivatu sua mamanumaku piiʔi ivatu taansua niivatu taansua niŋaikani kuɾai takio misai arakiʦaʦəku
S.FORM: ca'aniacu nikuca'ancu ca'ania niivatu sua mamanumaku pii'i ivatu taansua, niivatu taansua ningaikani kurai takio misai arakicaceku.
S.PHON: ʦaʔaniaʦu nikuʦaʔanʦu ʦaʔania niivatu sua mamanumaku piiʔi ivatu taansua niivatu taansua niŋaikani ku[r|ɾ]ai takio misai a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦeku
S.TRANSL: It was after lunch time when my child Pii'i called me by phone, telling me that Takio was bitten by a snake. I was quite surprised.

S.FORM: ara-kicacə=ku t<un>mana ʔinia.
S.PHON: arakiʦaʦəku tunmana ʔinia
S.FORM: arakicaceku t<un>mana 'inia.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦeku tunmana ʔinia
S.TRANSL: I was surprised when I heard it.

S.FORM: makasua=cu=ku "ni-m-i-kai-naanu makaasua misa=ku. caʔania misaini tia=niŋai vaəsə," misa=ku. "kaʔanə=ʔai ʔikua ʔaisi c<um>a-cəʔəra caanə?" misa=ku.
S.PHON: makasuaʦuku nimikainaanu makaasua misaku ʦaʔania misaini tianiŋai vaəsə misaku kaʔanəʔai ʔikua ʔaiʂi ʦumaʦəʔəra ʦaanə misaku
S.FORM: makasuacuku "nimikainaanu makaasua misaku. ca'ania misaini tianingai vaese," misaku. "ka'ane'ai 'ikua 'aisi c<um>ace'era caane?" misaku.
S.PHON: makasuaʦuku nimikainaanu makaasua misaku ʦaʔania misaini tianiŋai vaese misaku kaʔaneʔai ʔikua ʔaiʂi ʦumaʦeʔe[r|ɾ]a ʦaane misaku
S.TRANSL: "How could it have happened that he was bitten by a snake in the daytime? Didn't he see it on the path?" I wondered.

S.FORM: makasua=cu maka-ʔəna i-vatu taŋsua makai makaasi-a=cu ʔacu=kani Kizan misai
S.PHON: makasuaʦu makaʔəna ivatu taŋsua makai makaaʂiaʦu ʔaʦukani ki*an misai
S.FORM: makasuacu maka'ena ivatu tangsua makai makaasiacu 'acukani Kizan misai
S.PHON: makasuaʦu makaʔena ivatu taŋsua makai makaaʂiaʦu ʔaʦukani ki*an misai
S.TRANSL: The phone rang again, to confirm that he was in Kizan now.

S.FORM: ara-kicaacə=ku kaʔan=ku taa-taa-taavalaʔə. ara-kicacə=ku t<un>mana.
S.PHON: arakiʦaaʦəku kaʔanku taataataavaɾaʔə arakiʦaʦəku tunmana
S.FORM: arakicaaceku ka'anku taataataavara'e. arakicaceku t<un>mana.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]akiʦaaʦeku kaʔanku taataataava[r|ɾ]aʔe a[r|ɾ]akiʦaʦeku tunmana
S.TRANSL: I was so surprised that I didn't know (he would be at Kizan). I was surprised when I heard it.

S.FORM: makasua=cu mu-caan=cu=ku ma-kaasi taanaasa, mu-caan=cu=ku ma-kaasi taanaasa, ʔacu=kani ʔaisi=pa=kani ʔacu=ava Kizan a-pa-savuana misai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu muʦaanʦuku makaaʂi taanaasa muʦaanʦuku makaaʂi taanaasa ʔaʦukani ʔaiʂipakani ʔaʦuava ki*an apasavuana misai
S.FORM: makasuacu mucaancuku makaasi taanaasa, mucaancuku makaasi taanaasa, 'acukani 'aisipakani 'acuava Kizan apasavuana misai.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu muʦaanʦuku makaaʂi taanaasa muʦaanʦuku makaaʂi taanaasa ʔaʦukani ʔaiʂipakani ʔaʦuava ki*an apasavuana misai
S.TRANSL: When I was home, it was certain that he was still being treated at Kizan.

S.FORM: makasua=cu mu-caan=cu ma-manu=maku cucuma-ini mu-kusa ʔinia c<um>əʔəra.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu muʦaanʦu mamanumaku ʦuʦumaini mukusa ʔinia ʦuməʔəra
S.FORM: makasuacu mucaancu mamanumaku cucumaini mukusa 'inia c<um>e'era.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu muʦaanʦu mamanumaku ʦuʦumaini mukusa ʔinia ʦumeʔe[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: Then some of my children went there to visit him.

S.FORM: makaasua sua taavalaʔ-an=aku.
S.PHON: makaasua sua taavaɾaʔanaku
S.FORM: makaasua sua taavara'anaku.
S.PHON: makaasua sua taava[r|ɾ]aʔanaku

S.FORM: makaasua=cu tari-viin=ku ʔinia, mu-usa=ku ʔinia c<um>əʔəra.
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu tariviinku ʔinia muusaku ʔinia ʦuməʔəra
S.FORM: makaasuacu tariviinku 'inia, muusaku 'inia c<um>e'era.
S.PHON: makaasuaʦu ta[r|ɾ]iviinku ʔinia muusaku ʔinia ʦumeʔe[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: Then I went there to visit him later.

S.FORM: tee=ku mu-usa na iitai kaa-vaŋvaŋ, mia-iisua a-pa-savuana.
S.PHON: teeku muusa na iitai kaavaŋvaŋ miaiisua apasavuana
S.FORM: teeku muusa na iitai kaavangvang, miaiisua apasavuana.
S.PHON: teeku muusa na iitai kaavaŋvaŋ miaiisua apasavuana
S.TRANSL: When I went to the medical university, all people were there at the hospital.

S.FORM: pu-aiʔi=ci=kimi taanaasa, ʔaisi=pa ʔinia ŋuanni ʔaisi.
S.PHON: puaiʔitʂikimi taanaasa ʔaiʂipa ʔinia ŋuanni ʔaiʂi
S.FORM: puai'icikimi taanaasa, 'aisipa 'inia nguanni 'aisi.
S.PHON: puaiʔitʂikimi taanaasa ʔaiʂipa ʔinia ŋuanni ʔaiʂi
S.TRANSL: We returned home while he was still there.

S.FORM: ŋuai=kiai takio iisi ʔinia a-pa-savuana.
S.PHON: ŋuaikiai takio iiʂi ʔinia apasavuana
S.FORM: nguaikiai takio iisi 'inia apasavuana.
S.PHON: ŋuaikiai takio iiʂi ʔinia apasavuana
